meta.note: The one source for every platform: packages/design-tokens/tokens.json in the repository. Each platform's code is generated from it; the design system's copy is this file.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: The page. Every page, and the canvas outside the timeline and the map, sits on it.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: The one layer above the page: settings groups, cards, fields, menus, dialogs, sheets and the floating tab bar. Always set apart from `bg` by a `border` hairline.

tokens.name: fill
tokens.usage: A block on a layer: an unselected chip, the segmented control's track, a tonal button, the keypad's digits, the date capsule and the Moment bubble. Not the pressed state, which is the `opacity-press` wash. Text on it is `tx` or `tx2`, never `tx3`.

tokens.name: fill-strong
tokens.usage: A step below `fill`: a small mark inside a `fill` block, the keypad's operators, placeholders for photos and skeletons. Text on it is `tx` or `tx2`.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: The 1px hairline: a surface's edge, between rows in a group, dividers. Only separates layers, carries no meaning.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: A control's edge: fields, an outlined button, a switch that is off, radios and checkboxes, a sheet's handle. At least 3:1 on `bg` and `surface`. Also the grey of "other" and the compared period in charts.

tokens.name: tx
tokens.usage: Body text and titles, on `bg`, `surface`, `fill` and `accent-soft` (at least 14:1).

tokens.name: tx2
tokens.usage: Secondary text and icons: subtitles, a row's supporting line, trailing values, unselected segments, on `bg`, `surface`, `fill` and `fill-strong` (at least 5:1); about 1.8:1 from `tx` and from `tx3`, three greys evenly apart.

tokens.name: tx3
tokens.usage: The faintest text and icons: hints, unselected tab icons, weekday headers, disabled text, only on `bg` and `surface` (at least 4.5:1), never on `fill`.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: The fill of a page's one main action (the ink button, the record button beside the tab bar, the chosen day in the date picker); the colour of `tx`. At most one a page.

tokens.name: on-ink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `ink`; the colour of `bg` (16:1).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one colour, for state only: chosen, on, in progress, a link, today. At least 5:1 on `bg`, `surface` and `accent-soft`. Never decoration, never the main button.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an `accent` fill: a switch's thumb, a checkbox's tick, a badge's number. Dark in the dark theme.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: The tint under what is chosen: a selected chip, a selected row. Text on it stays `tx`, icons are `accent`.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Deleting and errors: a field's error edge and message, a destructive action's text, at least 5:1 on `bg`, `surface` and `danger-soft`. Always with words, never colour alone.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text on a `danger` fill.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: The tint behind a destructive action, such as what a swipe to revert reveals.

tokens.name: income
tokens.usage: Money coming in, in the ledger (spending is `tx`). Blue-green rather than green, told from `danger` by lightness. At least 5:1 on `bg` and `surface`.

tokens.name: track
tokens.usage: A recorded track's line: trips, a day, playback and footprints on the map, 4px with round caps. The same colour as the site's playback route.

tokens.name: track-gap
tokens.usage: Where a track broke off (weak signal, not recorded, a stop squeezed out): drawn as a dotted `tx3` line, never a solid guess.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: The dark layer under controls and labels on photos, videos and the map, dark in both themes, with `on-media` on it.

tokens.name: scrim-bar
tokens.usage: Under bars across media (the viewer's top and bottom bars), and over media set back.

tokens.name: on-media
tokens.usage: Text and icons on media and on a scrim.

tokens.name: on-media-variant
tokens.usage: Secondary text on media.

tokens.name: launcher
tokens.usage: The blue behind the app icon, only for the launcher icon and brand use, never in the interface.

tokens.name: year-1
tokens.usage: Map year colour 1: taken in order from the earliest first visit, starting over after six. The same as the site's `packages/trip-map/src/theme.ts` and in both themes; white numbers on it reach 3.7:1, below 4.5, kept on purpose as the legend names the year. A palette exception: change both sides together.

tokens.name: series-1
tokens.usage: Ledger chart category colour 1, in a fixed colour-blind-safe order, the period's largest category first; the seventh on are summed as grey "other" (`border-strong`). A single series uses `accent`. A palette exception for charts.

tokens.name: series-2
tokens.usage: Ledger chart category colour 2, in a fixed colour-blind-safe order, the period's largest category first; the seventh on are summed as grey "other" (`border-strong`). A single series uses `accent`. A palette exception for charts.

tokens.name: series-3
tokens.usage: Ledger chart category colour 3, in a fixed colour-blind-safe order, the period's largest category first; the seventh on are summed as grey "other" (`border-strong`). A single series uses `accent`. A palette exception for charts.

tokens.name: series-4
tokens.usage: Ledger chart category colour 4, in a fixed colour-blind-safe order, the period's largest category first; the seventh on are summed as grey "other" (`border-strong`). A single series uses `accent`. A palette exception for charts.

tokens.name: series-5
tokens.usage: Ledger chart category colour 5, in a fixed colour-blind-safe order, the period's largest category first; the seventh on are summed as grey "other" (`border-strong`). A single series uses `accent`. A palette exception for charts.

tokens.name: series-6
tokens.usage: Ledger chart category colour 6, in a fixed colour-blind-safe order, the period's largest category first; the seventh on are summed as grey "other" (`border-strong`). A single series uses `accent`. A palette exception for charts.

families.mono: ui-monospace, "SF Mono", "JetBrains Mono", "Roboto Mono", "Droid Sans Mono", monospace

styles.name: num-display
styles.usage: Amounts and big figures: the ledger's monthly total, the amount being entered, a statistic's main figure.

styles.name: num-title
styles.usage: The day in a ledger day header, figures in statistics.

styles.name: num-body
styles.usage: Amounts at the end of rows, figures in columns.

styles.name: num-caption
styles.usage: Small figures: a Moment's time, the status bar, photo counts.

styles.name: title-page
styles.usage: A page's large title (tab pages and pages under them alike), folding to `title-small` as it scrolls.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Dialog and sheet titles, card titles.

styles.name: title-small
styles.usage: Group and section headings, the small title once the large one scrolls away, a row that needs weight.

styles.name: body-reading
styles.usage: A Moment's text. Generous line height for reading Chinese; the global default.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Interface text: list rows, fields, menus, dialog bodies, messages.

styles.name: body-small
styles.usage: Supporting lines, notes and footnotes; a note under a group is at most three lines.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Metadata: places, the weekday beside a date, field names, subtitles.

styles.name: micro
styles.usage: Badges, corner marks and the smallest text in map legends.

spacing.note: A 4dp grid. Code's dp is written as px here, one to one.

tokens.name: space-xxs
tokens.usage: Half a step, only inside small things: a label's padding, a badge's gap.

tokens.name: space-xs
tokens.usage: An icon close beside its text, a floating bar's padding.

tokens.name: space-s
tokens.usage: Between buttons, between a group and its note.

tokens.name: space-m
tokens.usage: A menu item's padding, between an icon and its text.

tokens.name: space-l
tokens.usage: A list row's side padding, where a row's divider starts.

tokens.name: space-xl
tokens.usage: Between groups, a dialog's padding.

tokens.name: space-xxl
tokens.usage: Between large sections.

tokens.name: gap-item
tokens.usage: Between things within a day or a section, such as a Moment and the bills around it; below a heading row; between days on a list of rows only (the ledger).

tokens.name: gap-section
tokens.usage: Between groups: settings groups, the runs of rows on a detail page.

tokens.name: gap-day
tokens.usage: Between days on a list that holds Moments, the widest gap on a list.

tokens.name: gutter
tokens.usage: A page's side margin on a phone.

tokens.name: gutter-wide
tokens.usage: A page's side margin on a wider window (medium width and up).

radius.note: Every corner is a continuous curve (squircle, `ContinuousRoundedRectangle` / `ContinuousCapsule`), not an arc; web previews only approximate it.

tokens.name: radius-check
tokens.usage: A checkbox's corner.

tokens.name: radius-small
tokens.usage: Thumbnails, small marks.

tokens.name: radius-medium
tokens.usage: Fields, settings groups, menus, messages.

tokens.name: radius-large
tokens.usage: Moment photos, cards, dialogs, a sheet's top edge.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Capsules: buttons, chips, segmented controls, switches, the floating tab bar and buttons.

shadow.note: Shadows are few and faint: none where a hairline sets a layer apart. From `softShadow`: blur = level × 6, offset down = level × 1.5, 10% black.

tokens.name: elevation-1
tokens.usage: Level 1: date labels, menus, messages, sheets, set apart by the hairline alone.

tokens.name: elevation-2
tokens.usage: Level 2: what floats over a photo, the map or the scrolling page: the tab bar, floating buttons, menus.

tokens.name: elevation-3
tokens.usage: Level 3: while held.

tokens.name: elevation-4
tokens.usage: Level 4: while dragged.

tokens.name: size-touch
tokens.usage: The smallest touch target, however small the thing is drawn.

tokens.name: size-icon
tokens.usage: An icon's default size.

tokens.name: size-icon-small
tokens.usage: Icons in buttons and chips.

tokens.name: size-button
tokens.usage: A button's minimum height.

tokens.name: size-chip
tokens.usage: A chip's height.

tokens.name: size-segmented
tokens.usage: The segmented control track's height (3 padding).

tokens.name: size-field
tokens.usage: A boxed field's minimum height; an unboxed one is 56.

tokens.name: size-row
tokens.usage: A one-line row's minimum height; 64 with a supporting line.

tokens.name: size-top-bar
tokens.usage: The height of the top bar's row.

tokens.name: size-fab
tokens.usage: A floating button's diameter.

tokens.name: size-tab
tokens.usage: Each tab's width in the tab bar (48 tall).

tokens.name: size-switch
tokens.usage: A switch's width (26 tall, a 20 thumb).

tokens.name: size-sheet
tokens.usage: A sheet's maximum width.

tokens.name: size-dialog
tokens.usage: A dialog's maximum width (280 at least).

tokens.name: opacity-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled content.

tokens.name: opacity-press
tokens.usage: The same-colour wash over what is pressed (in place of a ripple), in over 60ms.

tokens.name: opacity-hover
tokens.usage: The wash while hovered or focused.
